name: Choose the next improvement
description: Choose one next intervention according to the strongest observed bottleneck, then revisit this decision after evaluating it.
decision: what can I change to improve my solution?

children.name: Repair or accelerate execution
children.description: Choose correctness repair when output contracts fail and optimization when verified computation is the bottleneck.
children.decision: Should the next execution change correct outputs or reduce iteration overhead?

children.name: Repair the execution contract
children.description: Choose the repair that explains the earliest incorrect intermediate or failed execution.
children.decision: Which observable failure should be repaired first?

children.name: Restore sample and feature alignment
children.description: Join features and predictions by stable identifiers and restore the exact feature order expected by the model.

children.name: Load the matching model and preprocessing artifacts
children.description: Reconstruct the saved architecture, tokenizer, encoders and preprocessing configuration and verify that all checkpoint weights load.

children.name: Repair prediction routing and aggregation
children.description: Trace model outputs through fold loops and submission writing so that each intended prediction contributes exactly once.

children.name: Repair API, dependency and device contracts
children.description: Correct callback signatures, imports, dataframe operations and device placement using the actual library contracts.

children.name: Run a small end-to-end diagnostic
children.description: Run the complete failing path on a tiny representative batch and repair the first reproducible failure.

children.name: Make the pipeline practical to run
children.description: Choose an execution change from the measured source of delay, memory pressure or configuration fragility.
children.decision: Which execution change removes the measured iteration bottleneck?

children.name: Stream data and release model memory
children.description: Process data or models in bounded chunks and release large intermediates before the next stage.

children.name: Cache reusable features and predictions
children.description: Persist versioned features, intermediate outputs or trained models so that downstream trials can reuse them.

children.name: Use a reduced development run
children.description: Reduce folds, rounds or data for exploratory tests and restore the complete configuration for final evaluation.

children.name: Refactor with prediction parity checks
children.description: Centralize configuration and simplify duplicated code while checking predictions against the preserved working pipeline.

children.name: Improve the evidence for choosing changes
children.description: Choose the intervention that makes the next performance comparison interpretable.
children.decision: Should uncertainty be resolved by a new experiment or by redesigning evaluation?

children.name: Choose the next experiment
children.description: Choose between attribution, noise measurement, recovery, parameter search and ending an exhausted search.
children.decision: What experiment will resolve the current uncertainty most directly?

children.name: Run a controlled ablation
children.description: Change one factor or revert one component against a fixed baseline to attribute its effect.

children.name: Measure repeated-run variability
children.description: Repeat an unchanged configuration with controlled seeds and compare candidate deltas with the resulting score variation.

children.name: Restore the last verified configuration
children.description: Restore the complete last verified configuration after a regression before testing individual alternatives again.

children.name: Bracket and refine a parameter search
children.description: Probe a coarse range for one parameter, then refine around a reproducible improvement with other factors fixed.

children.name: Stop a saturated local search
children.description: Retain the best verified setting and redirect trials when recent perturbations fail to exceed uncertainty.

children.name: Improve the evaluation signal
children.description: Choose whether unreliable comparisons come from sample membership or from an incorrect or unsuitable selection metric.
children.decision: Should the validation rows or the scoring rule be changed?

children.name: Choose validation membership
children.description: Choose sample membership from dependence, label imbalance and population shift before interpreting model comparisons.
children.decision: Which validation partition best answers the deployment question?

children.name: Keep related samples in the same fold
children.description: Construct group-disjoint validation folds from entity, topic or cluster identifiers.

children.name: Preserve label balance across folds
children.description: Use label-stratified folds and verify the label counts in every training and validation partition.

children.name: Make validation represent the target population
children.description: Construct a disjoint validation population that represents the expected test distribution.

children.name: Change the holdout allocation
children.description: Compare holdout size or fold structure while preserving an independent estimate for model selection.

children.name: Reproduce an overlapping-fold diagnostic
children.description: Reproduce the observed special-subset fold assignment only as a diagnostic and assess any benefit on a separate untouched holdout.

children.name: Refit on all labeled data
children.description: After fixing model choices with independent evidence, refit on all usable labeled data for final inference.

children.name: Use the target metric for model selection
children.description: Implement the task metric correctly and compare its stopping decisions with a smooth surrogate on held-out data.

children.name: Inspect the raw data structure
children.description: Profile entity histories, time order, feature types and missingness before choosing a representation.

children.name: Change the information supplied to learning
children.description: Choose between new representations, feature-set size, preprocessing contracts and training-example coverage.
children.decision: Which information change addresses the observed input limitation?

children.name: Choose a new feature source
children.description: Choose a candidate representation from observable structure absent in the current feature matrix.
children.decision: Which missing information should be represented explicitly?

children.name: Expand entity summary features
children.description: Aggregate repeated observations into entity-level statistics, including recent-history and change features when appropriate.

children.name: Add domain interactions and metadata
children.description: Construct targeted interactions, ratios or metadata features motivated by observable structure in the inputs.

children.name: Add text structure and linguistic statistics
children.description: Compute document, paragraph or sentence statistics that expose length, structure and linguistic quality.

children.name: Tune sparse and latent text representations
children.description: Compare n-gram vocabulary filters and latent text representations on the same validation split.

children.name: Use frozen pretrained embeddings
children.description: Extract aligned fixed representations from pretrained encoders and compare their incremental value to the existing features.

children.name: Add cross-fitted prediction features
children.description: Generate out-of-fold predictions for training rows and matched test predictions as inputs to a downstream learner.

children.name: Choose feature-set complexity
children.description: Choose the feature-selection intervention indicated by current importance coverage and feature-group evidence.
children.decision: Should the next change prune, expand or ablate the current feature set?

children.name: Choose a ranked feature cutoff
children.description: Rank features within training folds and compare retained subset sizes without excluding new feature sources accidentally.

children.name: Expand the retained feature subset
children.description: Relax an overly restrictive feature cutoff and regenerate selection artifacts after feature additions.

children.name: Remove or restore a feature group
children.description: Compare a feature group with its absence under fixed training settings and retain it only if it helps.

children.name: Change input preprocessing
children.description: Choose one representation change while holding the trained model contract and other transforms fixed.
children.decision: Which aspect of the model input is mismatched or missing useful detail?

children.name: Match and ablate text cleaning
children.description: Compare raw text with normalization or targeted cropping using the tokenizer and formatting expected by the trained model.

children.name: Change image input resolution
children.description: Evaluate nearby input resolutions with matching checkpoints and fixed architecture and preprocessing.

children.name: Match or ablate input normalization
children.description: Verify training-time scaling, channel layout and normalization before comparing alternative input scales.

children.name: Tune the time-frequency representation
children.description: Compare spectral resolution, windowing and dynamic range settings while preserving checkpoint compatibility.

children.name: Tune raw-signal filtering and clipping
children.description: Compare signal sampling, frequency filters and amplitude clipping against the training-time transform.

children.name: Change the signal context window
children.description: Compare temporal windows or spatial crop regions while keeping the remaining representation fixed.

children.name: Change the input channels or modalities
children.description: Add or ablate a complementary channel or representation while checking that the trained model actually consumes it.

children.name: Choose missing-value treatment
children.description: Choose preprocessing according to the consuming model and evidence from missingness and scaling ablations.
children.decision: Should missing values be left native, explicitly imputed or accompanied by simpler numeric preprocessing?

children.name: Use native missing-value handling
children.description: Leave missing values unfilled for models that support them and compare with the imputed baseline.

children.name: Impute and encode for the consuming model
children.description: Fit imputation and categorical encoding on training rows and reuse the same transformations at inference.

children.name: Simplify numerical preprocessing
children.description: Ablate unnecessary scaling, rounding or sparse-column filtering while preserving the model input contract.

children.name: Choose training examples
children.description: Choose cleaning, external labels, pseudo-labels or distribution adjustment according to the source of missing or unreliable supervision.
children.decision: Which change to the training population is supported by the available data?

children.name: Filter or reweight unreliable and shifted examples
children.description: Compare inclusion of noisy, duplicated or distribution-mismatched training examples with targeted removal or weighting.

children.name: Add relevant external labeled data
children.description: Train with auxiliary labeled data after checking compatibility of labels and the target population.

children.name: Train with pseudo-labeled examples
children.description: Generate pseudo-labels for unlabeled examples and test the resulting checkpoint against labeled-only training.

children.name: Adjust class or population weights
children.description: Tune training weights for the observed class or population imbalance using the actual task metric.

children.name: Generate synthetic training examples
children.description: Compare interpolation or oversampling with the original training set without augmenting held-out evaluation rows.

children.name: Change how the model is fitted
children.description: Choose the next training intervention from target alignment, capacity, regularization, optimization and augmentation evidence.
children.decision: Which training change addresses the observed learning failure?

children.name: Transform the learning target
children.description: Build a regression-compatible or group-conditioned target from the observed outcomes inside each training fold.

children.name: Change the training target or objective
children.description: Align the target transform, output activation and loss with the task and verify its gradients and held-out behavior.

children.name: Change tree depth or leaf capacity
children.description: Increase or reduce tree structure capacity according to underfitting and validation evidence.

children.name: Tune model regularization
children.description: Compare penalties, dropout or row and column subsampling against observed overfitting.

children.name: Tune optimization and training duration
children.description: Coordinate optimizer, learning-rate schedule, rounds or epochs and stopping patience using learning curves.

children.name: Tune training augmentation strength
children.description: Compare label-preserving training transforms and their strength under the same split and training budget.

children.name: Replace the learned predictor
children.description: Choose a new training snapshot, backbone, head or boosting implementation while controlling surrounding inputs and outputs.
children.decision: Which replacement changes the current predictor most appropriately?

children.name: Select a compatible trained checkpoint
children.description: Replace a component with a compatible, independently evaluated training-run or training-stage checkpoint while fixing the surrounding pipeline.

children.name: Choose backbone scale or family
children.description: Choose between capacity scaling and a qualitatively different pretrained representation.
children.decision: Should the predictor gain capacity, shrink or change its representation family?

children.name: Increase backbone capacity
children.description: Evaluate a larger compatible backbone using checkpoints trained for its exact configuration.

children.name: Retain or adopt the smaller backbone
children.description: Prefer the smaller or established backbone when larger variants show no reproducible generalization benefit.

children.name: Switch backbone family or pretraining
children.description: Evaluate a different architecture or domain-pretraining source at matched input processing and training quality.

children.name: Choose the head change
children.description: Choose head structure using the current bottleneck and available compatible training configuration.
children.decision: Should the head be enriched, simplified or changed to fuse inputs?

children.name: Change the prediction head or feature fusion
children.description: Compare head complexity, attention or fusion operators with weights trained for that exact architecture.

children.name: Simplify the prediction head
children.description: Remove unnecessary head complexity and compare a shared or simpler head using matching trained weights.

children.name: Change how modality embeddings are fused
children.description: Compare concatenation with additive or multiplicative fusion while retraining a compatible classification head.

children.name: Switch the boosting implementation or variant
children.description: Compare boosting families or training interfaces using the same features, split and output convention.

children.name: Combine existing predictions
children.description: Choose between changing the candidate pool, the fixed-pool combination rule and test-time views.
children.decision: Which ensemble intervention addresses the observed limitation?

children.name: Choose prediction-pool changes
children.description: Choose a pool change from member quality, residual complementarity and marginal repeat benefit.
children.decision: Should the ensemble gain diversity, prune members or average more repeats?

children.name: Add a complementary ensemble member
children.description: Evaluate a candidate with different errors, architecture, targets or inputs as an addition to the current prediction pool.

children.name: Select the ensemble subset
children.description: Compare the full blend with individual and leave-one-out predictions and remove members that hurt the held-out metric.

children.name: Average additional folds or seeds
children.description: Average compatible independently trained folds or seeds and check the marginal benefit against the current subset.

children.name: Choose the combination-rule change
children.description: Choose whether to alter the score domain, member coefficients or learn a meta-model.
children.decision: Which part of the combination rule should change next?

children.name: Choose the averaging domain
children.description: Choose raw-score, rank or logit/probability aggregation using output semantics and held-out evidence.
children.decision: In which score space should the fixed predictions be combined?

children.name: Average unranked predictions
children.description: Average aligned raw scores or probabilities and preserve their magnitude information when rank conversion does not help.

children.name: Choose raw or rank-space averaging
children.description: Compare per-model rank averaging with the raw-score baseline and retain rank conversion only when it improves the held-out metric.

children.name: Choose probability or logit-space aggregation
children.description: Compare combining logits before the output link with averaging normalized probabilities, preserving valid output distributions.

children.name: Choose member weights
children.description: Choose weights using independent component quality and stability of previous coefficient searches.
children.decision: Should members receive equal or tuned contributions?

children.name: Use equal member weights
children.description: Use a uniform average when estimated quality weights fail to improve held-out performance.

children.name: Tune blend coefficients
children.description: Optimize relative member weights on aligned held-out predictions and recheck them after component changes.

children.name: Fit a cross-validated meta-learner
children.description: Compare a regularized meta-learner trained on out-of-fold predictions with a fixed weighted blend.

children.name: Choose test-time views
children.description: Choose test-time augmentation only when transformations preserve label meaning and help the current model.
children.decision: Should inference average transformed views or preserve the original view?

children.name: Average valid test-time views
children.description: Compare identity-only inference with deterministic or repeated label-preserving views and verify each transform by ablation.

children.name: Use identity-only inference
children.description: Disable test-time transforms that violate input semantics or fail to improve the current model.

children.name: Change the final prediction mapping
children.description: Choose scale correction, ordinal conversion or a targeted subgroup rule from the task output requirements.
children.decision: Which output mismatch calls for a calibration change?

children.name: Calibrate prediction scale or direction
children.description: Verify output links and direction, then compare held-out scaling, offsets or nonlinear calibration before downstream decisions.

children.name: Choose ordinal output conversion
children.description: Choose ordinal conversion from label granularity, metric behavior and independent calibration evidence.
children.decision: Should outputs use optimized boundaries, simple rounding or retain their existing values?

children.name: Fit or simplify ordinal thresholds
children.description: Compare held-out optimized thresholds with naive rounding and retune them when the upstream prediction distribution changes.

children.name: Use simple rounding
children.description: Use fixed rounding boundaries when fitted thresholds do not generalize better.

children.name: Preserve the current output mapping
children.description: Keep the verified continuous outputs when extra remapping changes no useful ordering or harms held-out performance.

children.name: Apply a validated subgroup correction
children.description: Compare a targeted metadata- or group-conditioned correction with the unadjusted predictions on held-out groups.

unassigned.reason: Only removes diagnostic logging after correctness was established; no performance or reliability choice is supported.
